storyCards.headline: Starman: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
David Bowie's "Starman" reached #65 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #65 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Starman was released in 1981.

Chart story — peaked at #65 on the Hot 100.
